verdict.rationale: Rollbar's first-party docs describe Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error, writes a tested fix, and opens a pull request for human review or approval, which directly matches the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of repo/VCS integration setup and supported providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of PR quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review

citations.quote: Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.
Resolve writes a tested fix and opens the pull request for you to approve.
